title: Rogue Breaker
description:
Rogue Breaker is a fast paced, arcade style roguelike where players build the perfect run to score as many points as possible within the time limit.

Build up your inventory to boost your score, fire lasers, cause explosions, amass a fortune, and spawn an ungodly amount of balls.

Features• Roguelike gameplay - Randomized items make every run unique

• Over 120 items - Choose the best to break your run wide open

• Multiple difficulties - Breeze through on easy or tackle the games greatest challenge on nightmare
description_short: Break, blast, and crash through this arcade style Rgouelike. Assemble the perfect item set and leave no brick standing.
